a.name: Ruled index
a.description: Ten sections as a numbered index under a question heading: numeral, name and one-line summary; five rows and a 5 more disclosure on phones.
a.differs_from: A headed, numbered index of ruled rows with a summary line each; the shipped PageNav is an unheaded wrapping row of pills with names only.

b.name: Three stages
b.description: The sections sorted into Choose, Pay and book, and Bring home, as three ruled link columns on a full-width steel band.
b.differs_from: Grouped by buying stage into three ruled columns on a steel band; the shipped PageNav is one ungrouped row of pills on the page surface.

c.name: Photo index
c.description: A sunk steel-100 panel with a puppy photo at the left and the sections as generous arrow rows in two columns beside it. Five rows and a disclosure on phones.
c.differs_from: A photo beside the list inside a sunk panel, with a question heading and arrow rows; the shipped PageNav carries no image, no heading and no panel.
